This API allows you to register a user defined callback, which the Communication
Management has to call in case new event data is available since the last call to
GetNewSamples()
. The registered function needs NOT to be re-entrant as the Com-
munication Management has to serialize calls to the registered callback.
It is explicitly allowed to call
GetNewSamples()
from within the registered callback!
Note, that the user can alter the behavior between event-driven and polling style any-
time as he also has the possibility to withdraw the user specific “receive handler” with
the
UnsetReceiveHandler()
method provided by the event wrapper.

ara::com
